description: The webview talks to the core and nothing else: no filesystem plugin, no shell. The dialog chooses a folder to scan - a volume is chosen from the list the core reports, not through a file picker - and a rules file to add or where to save a copy of one; the core reads and writes the file, never the page. The window permissions are there because midda draws its own title bar, as kilna and scheda do: dragging, resizing and the three buttons are the page's to do, and the page shows the window once it has painted, so that nothing white is ever seen.
